_doc: Prompt descriptors for dungeon sets (hdart/dungeon.py, Studio > Dungeon). Tiles: all groups + the piece text, painted onto a geometry template with img2img. Props: medium + style + rendering + biome + prop_view + piece text + prop_framing. CFG 1: no negative prompts, say what you want.

medium.hint: What kind of image it is. No pixel words: pixelation is the Pixelate slider (a downsample after generation). The pixel-art LoRA is off unless you set LoRA on a generation; it wants 'pixel art sprite' here.

style.text: fine details, clean, stylized edges, almost voxel/texel, whimsical
style.hint: Game references steer strongly. Try 'Sea of Stars', 'Hyper Light Drifter', 'Darkest Dungeon'.

view.text: isometric view, 2:1 dimetric projection, seen from above
view.hint: Tiles follow the template geometry anyway; this keeps the shading/perspective consistent.

rendering.text: clean dark outlines, cel shading, hard edges, crisp pixels, limited palette, soft shadows in the cracks
rendering.hint: Line + shading language. Extras: 'moody', 'high contrast', 'muted earthy colours', 'painterly'.

framing.text: single tile, centered, game asset, plain white background
framing.hint: White background is used to cut props out.

biome.text: ancient crypt, worn grey stone, dust and cobwebs, dark fantasy
biome.hint: The set's look. Swap per biome: 'flooded sewer, mossy green brick', 'lava forge, black basalt and glowing cracks'.

prop_medium: pixel art sprite, single 16-bit game object sprite, modern high-resolution pixel art
prop_framing: single object, centered, full object visible, isolated on a pure flat white background
